notes.title: New game 'Please Duology' released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40083256/0095ae00589dd8b3897eab2ead8f4979371d84d0.png[/img]
Today we release our newest title : Please Duology. A compilation of two previously-released titles with added content, this duology presents two cosmic horror tales about humankind's fight against a mysterious race of bizarre creatures. Two ambient walking simulators heavy in atmosphere.

The first game, Please, tasks you with maintaining a power station. Simple enough. Just do what you're told and ignore the wails coming from the machines. We asked you so nicely.

The second game, Please Follow, has you walk through the trenches of a desperate, losing war, as you discover secrets better left unseen.

An added supplement, Please Read, rewards players who thoroughly explore both games with unlockable documents explaining more of the cryptic Please universe. And who knows, maybe you'll unlock a secret ending...

The game can be found here :

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1737620/Please_Duology/

We hope you enjoy this new trippy experience.

notes.title: New Somewhat Software Game Released!
notes.content:
Today, Somewhat Software releases their new experience, [i]The Shape On The Ground[/i]. 

Is it similar to [i]I Make Saints[/i]? Not really... well, a little... but no...?

Explore a desolate city in search of evocative dioramas and answer a simple question : What do you see?

A cross between a moody walking simulator, a Brothers Quay animated short movie, and a Tarot card reading, TSOTG is an interactive experience like no other. 

If you've enjoyed the mood and weirdness of [i]I Make Saints[/i], there's plenty more to find in [i]The Shape On The Ground[/i].

You can have a look at the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1633830/The_Shape_On_The_Ground_Steam_Edition/]on its store page by clicking here[/url].

ALSO!
If you've been holding off on trying [i]I Make Saints[/i], there is now a bundle of both it and TSOTG available now! Get 15% off of the price of both games by getting your hands on the bundle.

Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21424/Somewhat_Soft_Back_Catalog/]the bundle by clicking here[/url].

notes.title: That Red Saint Card Is Here To Stay
notes.content:
[b]It took us a week, but we finally found the culprit in the case of the disappearing Saint Card : the card itself! [/b]
Turns out the Red Saint card was slowly drifting off the game map over time and if players took more than 7-8 minutes finding it, it would disappear through the outer walls of the game space. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40083256/1ba315060b5e6a3f8584d48227b84caf41e1391d.png[/img]
Pictured here are two cards, one new to check position, and the original card, slowly phasing through the wall, probably to attempt to escape the dark reality we put it in. 

List of changes for build 1.1.2 :
-Activated VSync for every graphical quality level, so as to not make your PCs blow too much wind with their fans
-Fixed the drifting game objects issue

You might have to uninstall the game and reinstall it from your Steam App to play the corrected updated version.

Also,[b] if your antivirus is triggered when attempting to launch the game[/b], fear not! Since we reverted back to Unity 2017, this is an old issue where specific files are quarantined, but it's a false flag. Please create necessary exceptions within your antivirus software in order to launch the game. 

For more information on this specific situation, please read [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=4361-MVDP-3638]Steam's Official Support Page about antivirus interference[/url].

notes.title: Update version 1.1.1 (patch notes) : Antivirus Issue, please read
notes.content:
Updated / downdated the game back to the most reliable earlier build known, downgrading from Unity 2018 to Unity 2017. Includes :

-Fixed the Out Of Array error that slipped by and caused the random issues to happen to certain players, but not all. 
-Rebaking of lighting in Orphanage environment, which will now look different from the Unity 2018 version.

[b]Downgrading to Unity 2017 might make your antivirus software trigger and isolate specific files.[/b] Please be sure to create an exception to the files necessary for the game to launch. For more information on this issue, please read the [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=4361-MVDP-3638#:~:text=Anti%2Dvirus%20applications%20often%20interfere,issues%20with%20your%20Steam%20games.]official Steam Support page about antiviruses[/url].

notes.title: I Make Saints Release Discount
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40083256/38034f17ee22e8055b3b65981a8d0dd8ab0a4ca5.png[/img]

Released on April 5th 2021, Somewhat Software's first game [i]I Make Saints[/i] is 15% off on its already low price of 2.99US$ to celebrate its launch!

Originally released in 2017, [i]I Make Saints[/i] is a grimy, gloomy exploration of a diseased mind committing awful crimes. The 2021 new Steam Edition adds a new environment to explore and a few fixes for a better overall experience. 

Play it now!

notes.title: I Make Saints release date announced
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40083256/5f5a5c48aca79f69878c9adea766e9babe5e72e5.png[/img]
Prepare to experience the dark cult classic underground indie game [i]I Make Saints[/i] on Steam, on [b]April 5th 2021[/b]. 

Somewhat Software finally brings their very first game, originally released in 2017, to Steam in an exclusive new Director's Cut edition. 

Get ready to dive into the mind of a disturbing individual again, as you go deeper into their psyche in an entirely new environment previously unavailable anywhere else, hear a new track unused in the original release and get an overall better gaming experience with small tweaks here and there.

For newcomers, ready yourselves for a short but disconcerting walking simulator about the unspeakable crimes of a mind longing for a redemption they will never find.

Welcome to guilt.
